title: Understanding Linear Independence
text: To determine if the set of columns is linearly independent, consider if any column can be expressed as a linear combination of the others. If not, they are independent.

title: Span of the Columns
text: The span of a set of vectors (or columns) is the set of all possible linear combinations of those vectors. If the span of the new columns is the same as the original, they cover the same space.

title: Conclusion on Linear Independence and Span
text: If the new columns do not change the span and are not linear combinations of the existing columns, the set remains linearly independent and the span is unchanged.
